tools.description: Calculate how much of a sweetener matches the sweetness of a given amount of sugar (sucrose), the calories saved, and the bulk (grams of solids) lost that must be replaced with fiber, polyol or another bulking agent. tools.name: list_racc_categories
tools.description: List FDA Reference Amounts Customarily Consumed (RACC, 21 CFR 101.12) product categories used for Nutrition Facts serving sizes. Returns each category's id, group, name, reference amount and household measure hint. Optional filter words, e.g. 'cookie', 'carbonated beverage' or 'sauce'.

tools.name: search_label_ingredients
tools.description: Search the SKS nutrition ingredient library (largely USDA-based) for an ingredient's nutrients per 100 g, label declaration name and allergens. Each result says where its data comes from and which nutrients are missing.
